title: Auth — OOB Request — payload
description: A starter asks a service to open an out-of-band request that an approver will decide on another device. The document is issued and signed by the starter's fresh Ed25519 key, which is fixed for the life of the request. For `deviceEnrol` it also names the client and the scope ceiling it asks for. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

client.description: For `deviceEnrol` only, and then REQUIRED: who asks to be enrolled. MUST be absent for `login`.

requestedScope.description: For `deviceEnrol` only, and then REQUIRED: the ceiling the client asks to be enrolled under. MUST be absent for `login`.

Response.title: Auth — OOB Request — response payload
Response.description: The handle of the new request and the instant its claim window closes. The starter builds the trigger link from these and the service's DID.

claimClosesAt.description: The instant by which the request must be claimed, as an RFC 3339 date-time. The trigger link's `_exp` carries the same instant in the link's own integer form: the starter converts this value into it when it builds the link. At most 180 s after the request was accepted; 120 s is RECOMMENDED.
